# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the policy or package change and why consumers need it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run release:verify`
- [ ] `npm run test:consumer`
- [ ] Generated configs were updated only through `npm run build`
- [ ] Shared and local MegaLinter paths remain synchronized

## Consumer impact

State whether the change is patch, minor, or breaking and identify affected linters.
